## Additional Features - **Building Collision** — A buildings index is included for all non-filtered buildings, each carrying a per-building foundation depth in in-game meters. Depths scale with building height and footprint width and are bounded to the **−10 m** to **−80 m** range: single-family homes and low-rise structures anchor at the floor, while supertall towers with deep bedrock piles (Taipei-101 class) reach the cap. Freestanding towers, masts, chimneys, and other slender non-occupiable structures are detected by shape and floored to the **−10 m** minimum. Foundation depths drive underground tunnel-clearance collision and are also emitted as a visual `foundations` pmtiles layer visible on the in-game map. Buildings come from NLSC LoD1 (_內政部國土測繪中心 3D 精緻建物模型_), which carries surveyed per-building height and floor count for the entire island. - **Water Depth Index** — A water depth index restricts track placement in inland water bodies (rivers, lakes, reservoirs) using a flat **−5 m** index that prevents surface-level track placement. _Coastal bathymetry (Taiwan Strait + Pacific) is scheduled for a future v2 update once an offshore depth source is registered._ - **Neighborhood Labels** — Three layers of place name labels are embedded in the map: - _City labels_ — Special municipalities (直轄市) and provincial cities (省轄市) at the metropolitan scale (e.g. 臺北市 / Taipei). - _District labels_ — Names of all districts and townships (區 / 鄉 / 鎮 / 縣轄市) within the map boundary. - _Neighborhood labels_ — Village-level names (里) from the MOI 村里界圖 (Village & Borough Boundary) dataset published by the National Land Surveying and Mapping Center. ## Methodology This map is generated through a six-phase pipeline that transforms Taiwanese government census and employment statistics into georeferenced origin/destination demand points. **Point Seeding:** Candidate points are placed within each _里_ (village/borough) using population-weighted centroids derived from the NLSC 國土利用調查 (National Land Use Inventory) Level-2 raster (~10 m grid) combined with a 100 m residential-mesh density signal — a Non-Negative Least-Squares (NNLS) calibration against DGBAS 2020 Population & Housing Census employed-resident counts disaggregates the raster floor area into per-村里 candidate weights. **Mesh Reconciliation:** Initial point populations are refined by solving a constrained convex optimization that approximates each point's mass to residential and economic mesh ideals while preserving DGBAS 2020 Population & Housing Census (主計總處人口及住宅普查) per-village workplace × residence ground truth. **Aggregation:** A per-county Option A scaling factor reconciles the universe mismatch between the 2021 工商業普查 (Industry & Services Census) workplace persons-engaged count and the 2020 Population & Housing Census all-employed universe (including agriculture + public-sector). Agriculture employment is dropped at the township grain using the DGBAS census employment-status breakdown to avoid placing rural-residence farmers in workplace buildings. **Commute Assignment:** Commute flows are assigned using a gravity model with distance-decay, calibrated against per-county and per-township workplace × residence O/D matrices published by DGBAS for the 2020 census. A cordon-snap pass injects out-of-bundle commute mass from neighbouring counties as anchored sinks at TW county centroids; a Generalized IPF (GIPF) pass then pins each township's self-loop share to the per-township census ground truth. **Special Demand Injection:** Non-commuter demand generators — airports, universities, hospitals, passenger-ferry terminals, cultural / sport / tourism attractions — are injected as an additive layer. Military-installation demand remains a future expansion item pending public garrison data. **Layout Reconciliation:** A final spatial pass resolves point overlaps and ensures map clickability while keeping special-demand locations fixed. ## Data Sources All demand modeling is derived from freely available Taiwanese government statistical datasets and public geospatial resources. ### Census & Demographics - **2020 Census Commute O/D** (per-county and per-township workplace × residence O/D matrices) — [DGBAS](https://www.stat.gov.tw/) - **2021 Industry & Services Census** (110年工商業普查 — per-township workplace persons-engaged with industry classification and officer/worker split) — [DGBAS](https://www.stat.gov.tw/) - **Monthly Village Population** (內政部戶政司村里人口統計 — per-里 household-register stock) — [MOI Department of Household Registration](https://www.ris.gov.tw/) ### Geospatial Reference - **National Land Use Inventory** (內政部國土利用調查 NLUI — Level-2 land-use classification raster, ~10 m grid) — [MOI NLSC](https://maps.nlsc.gov.tw/) - **NLSC LoD1 Buildings** (內政部國土測繪中心 3D 精緻建物模型 — per-building footprint with surveyed height and floor count, island-wide) — [NLSC 3D Maps](https://3dmaps.nlsc.gov.tw/) - **Administrative Boundaries** (內政部村里界圖 VILLAGE_NLSC — village/borough polygons with county/township/village keys) — [MOI NLSC](https://data.moi.gov.tw/MoiOD/) -
